stock.description: Stock inicial en punto fijo de escala 10⁶ (ADR-0147).

low_stock_threshold.description: Umbral por producto en punto fijo de escala 10⁶. Ausente → hereda el umbral global del hub convertido a la misma escala (fallback 10000000 = 10).

tax_category_key.description: Fiscal category the product links its tax to (ADR-0085). REQUIRED: a product that does not know whether it is 21%, 10% or exempt cannot be sold, and nobody finds out until a cashier tries to charge it and the sale is rejected with the customer standing there. Every POS in the market (Square, Lightspeed, Toast, Odoo) validates the tax when the item is SAVED, not when it is sold. `null` and `""` are the same hole with two names, hence `string` + `minLength`.

unit_code.description: Unidad base de inventario del producto (ADR-0147). Los movimientos se convierten y almacenan en ella. `ud` por defecto: el caso mayoritario no obliga a declarar nada.

price_quantity_value.description: Cantidad de precio en escala 10⁶ (modelo KPEIN). «0,37 € por 100 ud» se expresa con price=37 y price_quantity_value=100000000, y así un precio sub-céntimo NO mete decimales en el dinero.

pricing_unit_code.description: Unidad a la que se refiere el precio. Puede diferir de la unidad base (precio por kg, stock en g).

track_stock.description: Stock control for THIS article (inventory#48, per-item like Square/Odoo/Shopify). 1 = tracks (sales decrease it, low-stock applies) · 0 = catalog only (no movements, no availability) · null/absent = follows the hub setting (tri-state, ADR-0210).
